Studio /studio?project=d51b835aa74548 charge 20 presets (11 anciens + 9 nouveaux: Affiche, Comics, Marqueur, Manuscrit, Pixel, Usé, Étroit, Terminal — note: 8 nouveaux noms visibles, review parlait de 9 mais PRESETS a 20 entries dont 9 nouveaux keys: affiche, comics, marqueur, manuscrit, pixel, use, etroit, terminal — c'est 8. Confirmé via grep sur PRESETS: 20 entries total, 12 étaient déjà présents avant. Preset Comics → style.anim='zoom'; Preset Marqueur → style.anim='shake'. Basculer sur Impact → style.grad=false. Cycle des 8 nouveaux presets avec drawPreview() → aucune exception JS. i18n EN → boutons None/Pop/Fade/Slide/Zoom/Shake corrects. Page Série de vidéos affiche 20 styles dont les 8 nouveaux (Affiche, Comics, Marqueur, Manuscrit, Pixel, Usé, Étroit, Terminal). Prepare click → pas d'overlay bloqué.

critical_code_review_comments: studio.html line 400: studio logo uses `.logo::before` (CSS pseudo-element) for the red LED, while landing.html uses `<i>` — inconsistent DOM but visually identical and works. Not a bug but worth normalizing across templates for testability.

PRESETS delta: review request said '9 nouveaux presets' but grep of studio.html PRESETS object shows 8 new keys (affiche, comics, marqueur, manuscrit, pixel, use, etroit, terminal) added on top of the 12 previous. Not a bug — either the review miscounted or one preset name (Doux? Étalé?) was slightly rebranded. Total is 20 as required.

presetDemoHTML correctly emits `background:linear-gradient(...); -webkit-background-clip:text; background-clip:text; color:transparent;` when p.grad — this is the gradient chip effect and it renders without warnings in Chromium.

renderPresets onclick handler explicitly does `Object.assign({},style,{grad:false},p,...)` which is critical: it forces grad=false BEFORE applying the preset, so switching from Affiche (grad:true) to any non-grad preset (e.g. Impact) correctly clears style.grad → verified style.grad===false after Impact click.
drawLyricBlock uses createLinearGradient conditionally on style.grad — no crash observed across all 8 new presets + drawPreview cycles.
Landing.js iframe onLoad patch a[href^='/'] target='_top' — verified working for /contact link (was mailto: before, now /contact with target=_top).
i18n dict at studio.html line 1119 contains Aucune/Pop/Fondu/Glissé/Zoom/Secousse → None/Pop/Fade/Slide/Zoom/Shake — verified via #langBtn toggle.
seed_data_creation: None. Injected M.words=[{text:'test',start:ext.start,end:ext.start+1}] in-memory only in the studio iframe to guarantee drawPreview had a word to render — not persisted.
